o.text: The take-senses are probably a semantic loan from Russian принимать (prinimatʹ).

From Proto-Turkic *batgak (“swamp, marsh”). Cognate with Chuvash путлӑх (putlăh), путлӑх (putlăh), etc.
Alternatively, a derivation of Proto-Turkic *bat- (“to sink; to fit into, get into”), whence also Azerbaijani batmaq.
